reasoning: E3 and E7 are both agent_proposed, so the record does not establish that the Special Draw Right carries a training condition; E7 states it only as an agent-proposed element. E1, established, says lineage crews carry channel repair under the Right from Book 20 and names no outside apprentices or condition. The stage is modal and its basis is stated as proposed, so it reads as creative speculation. The premise 'the condition the Right carries' must be treated as proposal, not record. No cited item states outside apprentices' repair.
quote: The Special Draw Right is conditional on training apprentices from outside the lineage.
alternative_reading: The claim offered no quote. Its premise rests only on agent-proposed E3 and E7; E1 states no training condition. Read as record, the condition is an agent assertion. Read as a proposal, the stage is coherent.
would_settle: An established item, not an agent_proposed one, stating that the Special Draw Right carries a training condition.
creative_room: The stage may propose outside apprentices trained under the Right, their repair shown, and the Right's condition then tested. Those must stay proposals until an established item states the condition. Open alternatives: test the lineage rota that E1 names, or leave the Right unconditional.

clauses.text: If outside apprentices are trained under the Special Draw Right
clauses.note: Holds only if the training happens. Its link to the Right is stated only in E7, an agent_proposed element; E1 names no outside apprentices.
A modal possibility the record does not contain. E3 says the condition needs demonstrating; no cited item states outside repair.

clauses.text: the condition the Right carries would then be tested
clauses.note: Presupposes a condition the Right carries. That condition appears only in agent_proposed E3 and E7; E1 states none. Treat as proposal, not record.

clauses.text: The stage asks what the lineage would then have to carry.
clauses.note: Lineage carrying channel repair under the Right is established in E1 from Book 20. What it would carry after outside training is modal.

defensible_possibility: A stage that proposes training outside apprentices under the Special Draw Right and then testing the condition, presented as proposal and not as a record of an existing condition.
